work.name: Neonomics
work.summary:
As a DevSecOps Engineer and ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, I architect and maintain our organization's holistic security posture. My work is grounded in our Information Security Management System (ISMS), which I am responsible for implementing and continually improving. This framework guides my approach to both in the software development lifecycle and managing our core IT infrastructure.

I translate ISMS policies into automated controls within the CI/CD pipeline, empowering developers to build secure-by-design applications. Simultaneously, this ensures our on-premises systems, corporate network, and user endpoints are managed with the same high standard of security. By bridging formal governance with agile development and practical IT operations, I transform security into a seamless enabler of innovation.
